options.name: alert_threshold_pct
options.description: Percent of filled reserve capacity to issue alert.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: group_name
options.description: Name of the snapshot consistency group or snapshot volume. Be sure to use different names for snapshot consistency groups and snapshot volumes to avoid name conflicts.

options.name: maximum_snapshots
options.description: Total number of snapshot images to maintain.

options.name: pit_description
options.description: Arbitrary description for a consistency group's snapshot images

options.name: pit_name
options.description: Name of a consistency group's snapshot images.

options.name: pit_timestamp
options.description: Snapshot image timestamp in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (AM|PM) (hours, minutes, seconds, and day-period are optional) Define only as much time as necessary to distinguish the desired snapshot image from the others. 24 hour time will be assumed if day-period indicator (AM, PM) is not specified. The terms latest and oldest may be used to select newest and oldest consistency group images. Mutually exclusive with I(pit_name or pit_description)

options.name: preferred_reserve_storage_pool
options.description: Default preferred storage pool or volume group for the reserve capacity volume. The base volume's storage pool or volume group will be selected by default if not defined. Used to specify storage pool or volume group for both snapshot consistency group volume members and snapshot volumes

options.name: reserve_capacity_full_policy
options.description: Policy for full reserve capacity. Purge deletes the oldest snapshot image for the base volume in the consistency group. Reject writes to base volume (keep snapshot images valid).

options.name: reserve_capacity_pct
options.description: Default percentage of base volume capacity to reserve for snapshot copy-on-writes (COW). Used to define reserve capacity for both snapshot consistency group volume members and snapshot volumes.

options.name: rollback_backup
options.description: Whether a point-in-time snapshot should be taken prior to performing a rollback.

options.name: rollback_priority
options.description: Storage system priority given to restoring snapshot point in time.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: When I(state==absent) ensures the I(type) has been removed. When I(state==present) ensures the I(type) is available. When I(state==rollback) the consistency group will be rolled back to the point-in-time snapshot images selected by I(pit_name or pit_timestamp). I(state==rollback) will always return changed since it is not possible to evaluate the current state of the base volume in relation to a snapshot image.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of snapshot object to effect. Group indicates a snapshot consistency group; consistency groups may have one or more base volume members which are defined in I(volumes). Pit indicates a snapshot consistency group point-in-time image(s); a snapshot image will be taken of each base volume when I(state==present). Warning! options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Should https certificates be validated?

options.name: view_host
options.description: Default host or host group to map snapshot volumes.

options.name: view_name
options.description: Consistency group snapshot volume group. Required when I(state==volume) or when ensuring the views absence when I(state==absent).

options.name: view_validate
options.description: Default whether snapshop volumes should be validated.

options.name: view_writable
options.description: Default whether snapshot volumes should be writable.

options.name: volumes
options.description: Details for each consistency group base volume for defining reserve capacity, preferred reserve capacity storage pool, and snapshot volume options. When I(state==present and type==group) the volume entries will be used to add or remove base volume from a snapshot consistency group. When I(state==present and type==view) the volume entries will be used to select images from a point-in-time for their respective snapshot volumes.
